_readme: Exceptions for the Phase U4 Supabase invariant checks.
Every entry needs a REASON that says where the object actually lives, or why it must not exist,
and how that was verified. Do NOT add an entry to make CI green: a phantom table means writes
are being silently discarded, which is exactly what these checkers exist to surface.
Both scripts FAIL if an entry here starts resolving, so this file can only shrink.

phantom_tables.xp_logs: FORBIDDEN, not missing. The database carries event trigger `xp_ban_guard` enforcing a zero-XP policy that blocks XP-shaped table, column and function names (including deliberate disguise patterns). Creating it raises 'XP_BAN: table "public.xp_logs" violates zero-XP policy'. Verified 2026-08-12 by attempting the migration. ACTION REQUIRED (product decision, not a bug fix): src/hooks/useTrainingAccountant.ts still writes XP here, so that write is dead by design and should be removed — do NOT resolve this by dropping the guard.
phantom_tables.user_dna_profiles: Never built. Both call sites (src/services/MediaUploadService.js:455 getStorageUsage, src/services/SocialService.js:691 getProfile) are READS with working fallbacks — a 1GB default and a caught throw. Verified 2026-08-12 that NO table in the database has its storage_used_bytes column, so it is not a rename of profiles. An empty table would change nothing; creating one would be inventing schema for a feature that was never specified.

stranded_writers.live_stream_analytics: It is a VIEW, not a table (verified via pg_class.relkind='v' on 2026-08-12), so it is derived and can never have a direct writer. This checker is deliberately static-analysis-only and has no database access, so it cannot tell views from tables on its own.
stranded_writers.user_daily_streaks: Has live data (1 row as of 2026-08-12), so a writer exists outside the scanned paths - most likely the smarter-poker-workers repo or a scheduled job. Re-verify and remove this entry if the writer is brought into this repo.
stranded_writers.posted_sports_clips: Feature RETIRED, not broken. Its writer (markSportsClipAsPosted) lives in archive/cron/horses-sports-clips.js, which this checker deliberately does not scan because archived code does not run. src/services/SportsClipDeduplicationService.js has no importer outside archive/. Verified 2026-08-12. Remove this entry - and the service - if the horses sports-clip pipeline is formally decommissioned.
stranded_writers.horse_sports_source_assignments: Same retired pipeline as posted_sports_clips - only reachable from archive/cron/horses-sports-clips.js via SportsClipDeduplicationService. Verified 2026-08-12.
stranded_writers.memory_challenge_completions: FALSE POSITIVE of this checker, kept as documentation of its blind spot. The table IS written - by the SQL function complete_daily_challenge(), which DailyChallengeService.completeChallenge() invokes via supabase.rpc(). Verified 2026-08-12 against pg_proc.prosrc: the body contains INSERT INTO memory_challenge_completions. check-stranded-writers is pure static analysis and only sees .from() writes and INSERT INTO in supabase/*.sql, so writes that happen INSIDE a database function are invisible to it. Do not remove this entry expecting the check to pass without it.

phantom_rpcs.reconcile_diamond_purchase_refund: DELIBERATE LEGACY FALLBACK, not a mistake. pages/api/store/webhooks/stripe.js calls the live fn_diamond_purchase_refund first and only falls back to this older name when PostgREST answers PGRST202 or 42883, never on a business error; the rename happened 2026-09-07 (it is not a reconciler, CLAUDE.md 10.12) and the fallback is the drop-migration safety margin. Verified 2026-09-24 that fn_diamond_purchase_refund IS live, so the primary path works and this branch is unreachable in production. REMOVE THIS ENTRY together with the fallback branch once the old name's drop has been released for long enough that no in-flight deploy can need it.
phantom_rpcs.get_horse_memories: Separate deployment unit, not served by this project's runtime. src/content-engine carries its own package.json and ContentScheduler.js is a CLI (`node ContentScheduler.js seed|schedule|publish`); pages/api/horses/analytics.js states the same thing in prose ("the content-engine pipeline, which is a different deployment unit from" the World Hub). Verified 2026-09-24 that nothing outside src/content-engine imports ContentCommander.js, ContentScheduler.js or HorseMemoryService.ts, so no World Hub request or cron route can reach this call. The five names are also absent from this project's database (3,010 public functions read from pg_proc on 2026-09-24), so if that pipeline is ever wired into the World Hub these entries must be removed and the functions created, not the other way round. ContentCommander.js:78 / HorseMemoryService.ts:83.
